summary: Split the design package's monolithic tokens.css and components.css into six smaller files (tokens-base, themes, themes-solarized, primitives, navigation-feedback, with components.css as an @import shim) and partitioned oversized CSS modules in apps/app/src/styles into per-file *-parts directories with import shims. Both refactors passed type-check and app build; a Prettier formatting failure on the design split was fixed with --write and the changes were committed as two separate commits.
decisions: Design package CSS split: tokens.css was cut at the `:root` base block (lines 0-57 → tokens-base.css), theme blocks up to solarized-light (lines 58-219 → themes.css), and the remaining solarized + default themes (lines 220+ → themes-solarized.css); tokens.css was reduced to just the @import shim.

Design package CSS split: components.css was split at line 239 into primitives.css (forms/buttons/inputs/selects/...) and navigation-feedback.css (tabs, navigation, toasts); forms.css was renamed to primitives.css and the import path in components.css was updated accordingly.

App styles partition: any CSS module over 300 lines was split into ~230-line chunks placed in a sibling `<name>-parts/part-N.css` directory, with the original file rewritten to contain only the @import statements; implemented via a one-shot Python script under .gizmo/split-css.py that was deleted after running.
Formatting policy: when PowerShell writes CSS files they end up with LF rather than CRLF, so a `--write` Prettier pass is required before commit to satisfy the repo's Prettier check.
errors: `pnpm exec prettier --check packages/design/src/*.css` failed with code 1, reporting formatting issues in navigation-feedback.css, primitives.css, themes-solarized.css, themes.css, tokens-base.css, and tokens.css — caused by LF line endings produced by the PowerShell split commands; resolved by running `prettier --write` followed by the commit.
